\begin{theorem}[Locality of linear circuit evaluation]
\lean{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval_congr_of_isLinear}
\label{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval_congr_of_isLinear}
\leanok
\uses{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval, TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval_add, TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval_smul, TCSlib.MPC.Circuit, TCSlib.MPC.Circuit.IsLinear, TCSlib.Shamir.Party}
\difficulty{4}
Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $\iota$ be an input-index type, let
$d\in\mathbb N$, let $R$ be a degree-$d$ resharer, and let $A$ be a finite set of
parties. Suppose two party-indexed input assignments $\mathrm{inp}$ and $\mathrm{inp}'$
agree at a party $j$ on every input label. Then every syntactically linear arithmetic
circuit over $F$ has the same BGW evaluation at $j$ under these two assignments.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Inputs dealt to participants]
\lean{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.dealtInputs}
\statementsource{Sha79}{pdf-a76120fbec44-p002-b003}
\statementsource{BGW88}{pdf-b3f55f2a4332-p003-b005}
\statementsource{AL17}{pdf-27f2b3787521-p004-b002}
\label{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.dealtInputs}
\leanok
\uses{TCSlib.Shamir.Party, TCSlib.Shamir.vecScheme}
Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\iota$
be an index type. Given a value function $v:\iota\to F$ and, for each index, a
polynomial of degree less than $k-1$, the dealt input for index $x$ and nonzero
participant $i\in F$ is the share of $v(x)$ obtained from that polynomial by the
$k$-participant vector sharing scheme over $F$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Privacy for Linear Circuits]
\lean{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.linear_perfectPrivacy}
\statementsource{BGW88}{

  pdf-b3f55f2a4332-p003-b009
}
\statementsource{AL17}{
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p021-b004,
  pdf-27f2b3787521-p022-b001
}
\label{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.linear_perfectPrivacy}
\leanok
\uses{TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval, TCSlib.MPC.BGW.bgwEval_congr_of_isLinear, TCSlib.MPC.BGW.dealtInputs, TCSlib.MPC.Circuit, TCSlib.MPC.Circuit.IsLinear, TCSlib.SecretSharing.AccessStructure.threshold, TCSlib.Shamir.Party, TCSlib.Shamir.vecScheme_perfectPrivacy}
\difficulty{3}
Let $F$ be a field, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $B$ be a finite set of nonzero
field elements with $|B|<k$. For any two assignments of field elements to the input
indices, there is a bijection of the families of input polynomials of degree less than
$k-1$ such that, for every family $q$ of such polynomials, every party in $B$, and every
linear circuit $C$, BGW evaluation on the first assignment using $q$ gives that party
the same value as evaluation on the second assignment using the image of $q$ under the
bijection.
\end{theorem}
